about: Groundwork work plan. Rolling wave: only the current ring is broken into items. Change status and evidence only, through scripts/agent/plan.py. See PROCESS.md.

items.title: Matt approves creating the public GitHub repo mrwatts88/groundwork
items.instructions: Say yes in a session. Creating a GitHub repo is outward-facing, so it waits for your OK.
acceptance: Matt has said yes in a session, recorded in plan/PROGRESS.md
items.evidence: Matt approved creating the repo in the setup session on 2026-11-11 and chose public: "Okay, let's create it. It can be public."

items.title: Publish the repo to public GitHub mrwatts88/groundwork and push main
acceptance: gh repo view mrwatts88/groundwork --json visibility -q .visibility prints PUBLIC
before the first push, a scan of the full history finds no secrets, API keys, tokens or personal email addresses
git rev-parse HEAD equals git ls-remote origin main
git status is clean
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-02. gh repo view visibility PUBLIC. History scan of all commits: 0 key or token matches, no credentials, no email in any file content, no risky files. The author and committer email in commit metadata is accepted by D-011, which Matt confirmed in session. HEAD a32a7ca equals git ls-remote origin main. git status clean. Two earlier verifier FAILs were on the email before D-011 was recorded and confirmed.

items.title: pnpm workspace scaffold: protocol, sim, minds, server, client packages, TypeScript strict, Vitest, check-fast wired
acceptance: ls packages prints client minds protocol server sim
every package tsconfig extends a root tsconfig with strict true
pnpm -s typecheck exits 0 and pnpm -s test runs at least one test per package and exits 0
make check-fast prints check-fast: ok and its output shows the typecheck and vitest runs
introducing a type error in packages/sim makes make check-fast exit non-zero (verifier tries it on a scratch copy or reverts it)
README.md and docs/dev.md exist and say how to install and run the checks
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-03. ls packages prints client minds protocol server sim. Every package tsconfig extends tsconfig.base.json (strict true). pnpm -s typecheck exit 0, pnpm -s test 5 files 6 tests exit 0, one or more per package. make check-fast shows typecheck and vitest runs and check-fast: ok. A sim type error made check-fast exit 2 (TS2322) on a scratch copy. README.md and docs/dev.md give install and check steps.

items.title: Sim core: seeded map generation, tick, seeded RNG, the command API apply(state, command), one command (place_road), state hash
acceptance: a Vitest determinism test advances a 128x128 seeded world 10000 ticks with a scripted command log twice and gets the same state hash
the same test run in two separate processes prints the same hash (a test:slow script or a small CLI the verifier runs twice)
a test rejects an invalid place_road (out of bounds, on water, on a parcel the Op does not own) with a typed error and leaves the state hash unchanged
a test in packages/sim fails if any source file under packages/sim/src contains Math.random, Date or performance.now
map generation from the same seed produces the same terrain and different seeds produce different terrain (tests)
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-04. vitest 10000-tick 128x128 determinism test passes (same hash twice, changed log differs, split run matches). pnpm test:slow: two node processes print hash=659408debd1ae3d5, determinism ok. apply.test.ts: out_of_bounds, on_water, not_owner and others are typed errors with the hash unchanged. purity.test.ts passes and catches a planted Date. Mapgen: same seed gives identical terrain and 5 seeds give 5 distinct terrains. check-fast green, 25 tests.

items.title: Server: clock (present, speed-up, away), WebSocket state and commands, SQLite snapshot plus command log, resume after restart, /health
acceptance: an integration test starts the server with a fast clock, connects a WebSocket client, receives the initial state and tick updates
the test sends place_road over the WebSocket and sees it in the next state, and an invalid command returns an error message
the test stops the server, starts it again on the same data dir, and the road is still there and the tick count continues from where it stopped
GET /health returns JSON with tick, game date, clock mode and connected client count
a test shows the clock switches to away mode after the configured idle time with no client input, and back on input
clock rates and the data dir come from config, with defaults matching DESIGN.md 11.1
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-05. Real server plus ws client: welcome and consecutive ticks, place_road in the next delta, already_road, out_of_bounds and malformed frames return errors, a restart on the same dir keeps the tick and hash (also across snapshots), /health has tick, date, clock and clients, away after idle and back on input, config defaults match 11.1, check-fast 44 tests green

items.title: Client: Vite + PixiJS isometric map from server state, pan and zoom, click to place a road, HUD with date and clock speed
acceptance: a Playwright smoke test starts a test server and the client, waits for the canvas, and saves a screenshot to test-results/
the screenshot shows an isometric terrain map with visibly different terrain types (verifier opens the image)
the smoke test clicks a land tile in road mode and the road appears in the next screenshot and in the server state
the HUD shows the game date and clock speed, read from the DOM by the test
the server serves the built client at / so one port does everything
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-06. Playwright smoke 2 passed: canvas drawn, 1-map.png shows isometric map with water, grass, forest, hills, rock and deposits, click in road mode puts a road in 3-road.png (pixel diff) and in server state (road[i] != 0, cash 10000 to 9990), HUD date matches Day N, HH:MM and advances, speed reads 1x live and 4x sped up, GET / and /health on one port. make check-fast ok, 55 tests.

items.title: Minds skeleton: Mind interface, fake backend, claude -p backend, schema-validated output, budget governor counting calls
acceptance: unit tests cover the fake backend replaying a recorded reply by prompt hash and returning schema-valid output

unit tests cover the claude -p backend against a stubbed process: it builds the exact flags in DESIGN.md 13.4, runs in an empty working dir, parses structured_output, and rejects malformed or schema-invalid output with a typed error
a unit test shows the governor refuses or defers calls past the per-hour limit and lets a conversation call through within its own limit
every call records a usage row (agent, backend, model, tokens, ms, ok) through an injected recorder
no test spawns the real claude binary (verifier greps the tests and runs them with claude off the PATH)
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-07. fake replays by prompt hash with schema-valid output; claude -p backend tested on a stubbed process (exact 13.4 argv, empty temp cwd, structured_output, typed errors); governor defers or refuses past 120/h, conversation within its own limit; usage rows on every backend call through an injected recorder; 81/81 tests with claude off PATH; check-fast ok

items.title: Fedora box prep: pnpm without sudo, repo clone, claude path and a lean headless call checked
acceptance: ssh -o BatchMode=yes laptop '~/.local/bin/pnpm --version' prints 10.x
ssh laptop 'git -C ~/code/groundwork rev-parse HEAD' equals the Mac's origin/main
the lean claude -p call from DESIGN.md 13.4, run over ssh from an empty dir, returns JSON with structured_output and under 3000 input plus cache tokens
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-08. pnpm 10.14.0 at ~/.local/bin on laptop. Clone HEAD b901f89 equals origin/main. Lean claude -p call from an empty dir returned structured_output, 1098 input plus cache tokens, 1.5 s.

items.title: Deploy: scripts/deploy.sh, systemd user service on the Fedora box, nightly SQLite backup timer
acceptance: scripts/deploy.sh run on the Mac pulls, installs, builds and restarts the service on the Fedora box, then prints the health JSON
curl -s http://laptop.local:7400/health from the Mac returns JSON with a tick that increases over 10 seconds
after ssh laptop 'systemctl --user restart groundwork', the tick resumes at or above its value before the restart
systemctl --user is-enabled groundwork prints enabled, and the backup timer is listed by systemctl --user list-timers
running the backup service once writes a copy to ~/groundwork-backups/ and keeps at most 14
docs/dev.md has a Deploy section
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-09. deploy.sh pushed, pulled, installed, built, restarted and printed health (tick 6). From the Mac, health tick went 6 to 7 and 7 to 8 over 10s. A restart resumed at tick 9 and reached 10 twelve seconds later. is-enabled printed enabled and the backup timer is listed. The backup service wrote a copy to ~/groundwork-backups, and retention left exactly 14 in a seeded temp dir. docs/dev.md has a Deploy section. check-fast is green, 81/81.

items.title: Live mind smoke on the Fedora box: one real claude -p call through the minds package
acceptance: ssh laptop 'cd ~/code/groundwork && ~/.local/bin/pnpm --filter @groundwork/minds smoke' makes one real call as a named NPC and prints a schema-valid reply
the smoke run records a usage row in the server's SQLite with tokens under 3000 and ok true
the smoke script is not part of pnpm test or make check
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-10. Real smoke on the Fedora box: status ok, schema-valid place_road reply as Ada Fenwick. mind_usage row 2: haiku, 1607 tokens, ok 1. Smoke script excluded from vitest include, test:slow and Makefile. sqlite.test.ts calls no model. Governor on.

items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-11. bash tests/rings/ring0.sh on the Mac ran make check, determinism, curl laptop.local:7400/health and the live minds smoke over ssh, ending ring0: ok (smoke 1587 tokens, 6063 ms, as Ada Fenwick, set -euo pipefail). shellcheck -S warning via stdin on the Fedora box clean. docs/dev.md row added.

items.title: Ring 0 review
acceptance: every Ring 0 done-when line in DESIGN.md 23.2 is checked and holds
tests/rings/ring0.sh exits 0
the commit is tagged ring-0
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-review. tests/rings/ring0.sh -> ring0: ok (exit 0). make check-fast green with plan lint, typecheck and 82 unit tests. Determinism hash 659408debd1ae3d5 matches across two processes, no Math.random or Date in packages/sim/src. The service on the Fedora box is enabled with linger on, health ok from the Mac, and a restart resumes at the same tick (62 to 62). Playwright on http://laptop.local:7400 drew the isometric map with no console errors. The fake Mind backend passes its tests, and the live smoke made one claude-cli call (haiku, 1635 tokens, schema-valid). The minds tests never call a real model. The world changes only through apply() in game.ts. Annotated tag ring-0 is on a502f25. README How to play updated.
